precision_invariants: Original verifier and unchanged ten boundary cases/thresholds are mandatory.

FP32 products/reductions and dtype cast modes remain unchanged. Newton refinements retain original operation order only for positive finite mean+epsilon; all other rows retain the original Rsqrt seed. This local arithmetic classification does not select a kernel.
For finite positive mean the row and pair outputs preserve the prior two Newton steps exactly; hardware Rsqrt/Compare/Select behavior still requires native correctness qualification.
semantic_invariants: For each last-axis row y = x * rsqrt(mean(x*x)+epsilon) * gamma; gamma shared read-only across rows.
Rows are independent; no cross-row reduction and no input-range specialization.
Hidden in [1,8192], numel positive and divisible by hidden, epsilon positive as baseline.

Entry selection is unchanged and metadata-only: key12 hidden2; key10 otherhidden1..128; key11 hidden129..8192; key0 fallback. Nonfinite handling is local numerical semantics, never tensor-dependent entry dispatch.
